Test Scenario: Execute same withdrawal message twice
Expected Behavior: Message should be idempotent and nonce-checked

Test Scenario: Submit message with fake payload
Questions: Can a fake sequencer submit state?
Expected Behavior: Only authorized signers should produce valid messages

Test Scenario: Submit withdrawal with invalid Merkle proof
Questions: Can a malicious relayer forge finality?
Expected Behavior: Proofs must be verified against canonical state root

Test Scenario: Replay message with same nonce but different payload
Expected Behavior: Each message must have unique nonce; replay must fail

Test Scenario: Submit message intended for chain A on chain B
Expected Behavior: Chain ID must be validated; cross-chain replay must fail

Test Scenario: Submit message that passes partial but not full verification
Expected Behavior: All verification steps must execute atomically

Test Scenario: Submit state root without being registered sequencer
Questions: Can a fake sequencer submit state?
Expected Behavior: Only registered sequencers can submit state roots

Test Scenario: Replay old state root as new
Expected Behavior: State root must include block height; replay must fail

Test Scenario: Submit state that doesn't follow consensus rules
Expected Behavior: State transitions must be validated against consensus rules

Test Scenario: Cast multiple votes with same token
Expected Behavior: Voting power must be based on token balance at snapshot

Test Scenario: Change token balance after snapshot but before vote
Expected Behavior: Snapshot must be taken at proposal creation; balance must be frozen

Test Scenario: Replay proposal from another chain or earlier time
Expected Behavior: Proposal must include chain ID and unique nonce

Test Scenario: Submit vote after voting period ends
Expected Behavior: Voting deadline must be enforced; late votes rejected

Test Scenario: Pass proposal without meeting minimum participation
Expected Behavior: Quorum must be checked; proposal fails if quorum not met

Test Scenario: Claim rewards twice for same period
Expected Behavior: Reward claims must be idempotent; each period claimable once

Test Scenario: Manipulate reward rate calculation
Expected Behavior: Reward rate must be deterministic and validated

Test Scenario: Replay unclaimed reward distribution
Expected Behavior: Distributions must be idempotent; state must track claimed amounts

Test Scenario: Register identity without proper verification
Expected Behavior: Identity must be verified through authorized KYC provider

Test Scenario: Use same identity for multiple accounts
Expected Behavior: Identity must be unique; duplicate registration must fail

Test Scenario: Use expired KYC credential
Expected Behavior: Credential expiry must be checked; expired credentials rejected

Test Scenario: Sign two blocks at same height
Expected Behavior: Double-signing must be detected and slashed

Test Scenario: Propose block with invalid transactions
Expected Behavior: Block validity must be verified by all validators

Test Scenario: Manipulate validator stake weight
Expected Behavior: Stake must be validated against on-chain state

Test Scenario: Mint tokens without proper authorization
Expected Behavior: Minting must require authorized role or governance approval

Test Scenario: Replay mint transaction
Expected Behavior: Mint must be idempotent; nonce must prevent replay

Test Scenario: Mint beyond maximum supply
Expected Behavior: Supply cap must be enforced; mint beyond cap must fail

Test Scenario: Exploit gas calculation to underpay
Expected Behavior: Gas must be calculated correctly; underpayment must fail

Test Scenario: Exploit gas refund mechanism
Expected Behavior: Gas refunds must be bounded and validated

Test Scenario: Manipulate gas price for profit
Expected Behavior: Gas price must be validated against oracle or fixed rate

Test Scenario: Submit settlement with invalid state
Expected Behavior: Settlement must verify state against canonical chain

Test Scenario: Replay old settlement
Expected Behavior: Settlement must include unique identifier; replay must fail

Test Scenario: Submit settlement that only partially settles
Expected Behavior: Settlement must be atomic; partial settlement must fail
